notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
🎉Graphite officially joins indie.io!🎉
Today we're thrilled to announce something very special: Graphite has formed a partnership with indie.io 🖤

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353684/da50e1327c70f7f78c9f4fa5821d7cc79b450c8a.png"]
About Graphite & Our Development Journey 
Since we started working on Graphite a little over a year ago, we wanted to create something original, but inspired by the RPGs and Roguelikes that we love, a game that we could be proud of. We wanted to explore an odd approach, making a really weird but appealing concept for the game, art style and gameplay. That is why we decided to make the game, because of the enjoyment it gives to us while making it, and we truly believe what we are making will give the people who play the game a lot of fun.

Thanks to this new alliance with indie.io, we'll be able to bring Graphite to more people, more corners of the world, and do it the way we dreamed: without losing our indie essence.
Why indie.io?
We were looking for a partner who could help us bring our game to more people without compromising our vision. After researching our options, indie.io stood out because they have a great track record with helping new indie developers reach more players. Other developers they've worked with have said great things about them, and they truly understand what it means to be indie - supporting creators while letting them maintain their unique voice.

For those who may not know: Working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.
🎯 What's next?
Don't forget to follow and wishlist Graphite as well as join our Discord community to be notified of future announcements! Your support means everything to us as we continue this incredible journey.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello, I have prepared a new build for the Steam Next Fest! This version adds a new character: The Monk! and addresses many pain points of the demo.

With five characters in the roster, parties should feel  a lot more varied.

Features

 New playable character: The Monk!
 New music
 New environmental sounds
 Background NPCs


Adjustments

 Losing in "The Test" no longer results in a game over.
 Sprites now appear shinier than before.


Fixes

 Multiple typos in tutorials and events.
 Some predictions were not being calculated correctly.
 You can no longer gain an alarm clock in the tutorial, which previously caused a soft lock.
